name: 22473 · Heathsville, VA
findings: ZIP 22473 (Heathsville) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22473 (Heathsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22473 (Heathsville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
